arguments.command:
python3 -c "
# February 1938 total expenditures: 528 (from table)
# January 1939 total expenditures: 693 (from table)
feb_1938 = 528
jan_1939 = 693

# Absolute percent difference = |A - B| / ((A + B) / 2) * 100
abs_diff = abs(feb_1938 - jan_1939)
avg = (feb_1938 + jan_1939) / 2
pct_diff = (abs_diff / avg) * 100

print(f'February 1938 expenditures: {feb_1938} million')
print(f'January 1939 expenditures: {jan_1939} million')
print(f'Absolute difference: {abs_diff}')
print(f'Average: {avg}')
print(f'Absolute percent difference: {pct_diff}')
print(f'Rounded to nearest tenth: {round(pct_diff, 1)}')
"
